text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: (Heh heh, cheering even after the finish line, are they? I cannot comprehend their thought process, but it is utterly fascinating!)

At Agnes Tachyon's reply,
squeals of excitement erupted from a corner of the audience.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I could hear occasional cheers during the race.
So I listened closely, and—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"It had a statistically significant effect on my muscular output!
That's what the data showed!
Yes, quite surprising even to myself!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It appears external and internal stimuli can excite my emotions as well!
No, perhaps this is simply what makes us social animals.

So... despite your twisted way of phrasing it,
you drew strength from the crowd's cheers, is that it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What's left this year is the Tenno Sho (Autumn)
and the Arima Kinen! There's plenty of time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I've steadily drawn closer to "what lies beyond an Umamusume's limits,"
that which I long for endlessly...!
